title: What's new in AniCult ✨
items: New logo! AniCult now has a fresh icon displayed in the header and as the site favicon
Added AniXo as a second video provider — switch between Megavid and AniXo with a one-tap toggle in the player
Sub and Dub are now always available, so you can switch audio instantly on any episode
Megavid embeds stay sandboxed so they can never redirect you away from AniCult
Cleaned up the codebase and removed unused features
